title: E-QTM-0153: GHZ, Mermin and monogamy on three knots: reading one role of each of three love-fear pairs on the GHZ...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0153 in the quantum arena: GHZ, Mermin and monogamy on three knots: reading one role of each of three love-fear pairs on the GHZ coset leaves a GHZ knot on the other three for all 27 outcomes, but its weights are non-negative, so with the model's own readings every one of its 26 perfect correlations is met by 27 local assignments and GHZ's argument does not go through for qutrits, while two-outcome observables outside those readings give Mermin 10/3 > 2; CKW holds on the GHZ knot and fails on the antisymmetric stand-in (Ou 2007), and is read with certified bounds on the knit's own triples.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
